system.implants: Basic Biomods, Basic Mesh Inserts, Cortical Stack, Cyberbrain, Mnemonic Augmentation, Puppet Sock
system.advantages: +5 to one aptitude of the player’s choice
system.description:
Basic pods are essentially lowercost pod versions of a splicer morph. To keep expenses down, this pod has slightly more mechanical parts than most other pods. As a result, it has more obvious cybernetic components.

Source: Eclipse Phase Morph Recognition Guide, p. 10.
